name: Sherman–Morrison rank-one linear-system update
definition: Given invertible A and A+uvᵀ, solve Ay=b and Az=u; x=y−z(vᵀy)/(1+vᵀz).
variables: A base matrix; u,v update vectors; b right side; y,z base solves
assumptions: Nonsingular A and nonzero update denominator; check finite precision.
limitations: Near-zero denominator can amplify error; existing factorization required for efficiency.
failure_conditions: Zero or near-zero denominator; failed residual check
computation: Reuse base solves; verify updated-system residual.

source.citation: Provisional: Eric Darve, Numerical Linear Algebra, The Sherman-Morrison-Woodbury Formula. Verify exact source before admission. https://ericdarve.github.io/NLA/

required_inputs: Base matrix or factorization, right side and update vectors.
incompatible_methods: Ignoring singularity of the updated matrix

name: Block orthogonal eigeniteration
definition: For an n by p initial orthonormal Q₀, compute Z=AQ_k then thin QR Z=Q_(k+1)R_(k+1). Approximate the invariant subspace using Q_k.
variables: A matrix; p block dimension; Q orthonormal basis; R triangular factor
assumptions: Symmetric A, dominant magnitude spectral gap, initial subspace with nonzero full-rank projection onto target; p>1.
limitations: Clustered eigenvalues and insufficient initial overlap slow or prevent convergence.
failure_conditions: Rank loss or invariant-subspace residual failure
computation: Alternate block multiplication and QR; check invariant-subspace residual.

source.citation: Provisional: Eric Darve, Numerical Linear Algebra, The Orthogonal Iteration Algorithm. Verify before admission. https://ericdarve.github.io/NLA/

required_inputs: Matrix, starting orthonormal block, tolerance and iteration limit.
incompatible_methods: Claiming individual eigenvector convergence without appropriate gaps
